scenes.title: Moscow lawyers
scenes.summary: Lawyers from the Moscow firm 'Mishkin and Sons' arrive by train, visit Arkady in the communal flat, and confront Judge Ilya Olegovich Berg with a prosecutor's order for an urgent evening hearing to replace Arkady's house arrest with a travel ban; Arkady thanks them with a gift. Opening song.
scenes.location: railway station / communal flat / judge's office

scenes.title: Bad coffee and Lyolya
scenes.summary: In the communal kitchen Slavik and Lyosha watch a vlog; Arkady complains about the bad coffee and sausage, calls Yulia 'girl', and shows Slavik a photo of his glamorous girlfriend Lyolya, bragging that she chased him like a shark.

scenes.title: The listening post
scenes.summary: In a cold surveillance room across from the flat, Major Lavrov and Captain Zavarzin trip a fuse with their heater and kettle and listen to their directional microphone: they only hear Marina arguing with Edik and old Klavdia on the phone, and decide to plant a bug inside Arkady's room.

scenes.title: A flat with a balcony
scenes.summary: Pasha shows Samson and Nina a renovated three-room flat with a balcony and an occupancy order in Samson's name, in exchange for getting Arkady to tell where the money is; Samson refuses to torture anyone, while Nina says they only need to scare him.

scenes.title: The hidden bug
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov and Captain Zavarzin give Marina a tiny bug on a sticky pad to plant at head height in Arkady's room while he is out, disguised inside a small foil wrapper so it raises no suspicion.

scenes.title: Tell me where the money is
scenes.summary: Pushed by Nina, Samson goes to Arkady's room and admits he was promised a flat if Arkady hands over 'the people's money'; Arkady guesses Pasha hired him, says they are friends now, claims he lost the money on the stock exchange, and mocks Samson's threats to torture him.

scenes.title: Walking Lyutik
scenes.summary: In the park Pasha tries to talk to Judge Berg, who is busy chasing his daughter's tiny dog Lyutik; Berg says the Moscow lawyer Mishkin overwhelmed them over procedural errors, and Pasha tells him they are handling Mishkin and orders him to keep Anikeev under house arrest.

scenes.title: He just sat there grinning
scenes.summary: Samson reports to Nina that he threatened to cut off Arkady's ear and gouge out his eye with a spoon, and Arkady just sat grinning; Nina scolds him for talking nonsense and Samson tells her to say what to do.

scenes.title: Bragging at school
scenes.summary: At school Slavik shows off the photo of Lyolya on his phone and repeats Arkady's brag, claiming she is his girlfriend; his classmates don't believe him and dare him to bring her to Dimon's party that evening or get a humiliating nickname.

scenes.title: Caught in Arkady's room
scenes.summary: While Arkady is in the bathroom, Marina slips into his room to plant the bug; Arkady returns, catches her hiding the small foil packet behind her back, and smugly assumes she has come to flirt with him before sending her away because his lawyer has arrived.

scenes.title: The public defender
scenes.summary: Instead of Mishkin, a stuttering public defender, Danila Golovkin, arrives at the flat; Arkady phones Mishkin, who says he must return to Moscow 'for family reasons' and tells him not to call again. (Cutaway: Pasha gives Mishkin a Sinyaozersk souvenir of murdered monks as a hint.)

scenes.title: Shopping for tools
scenes.summary: In a hardware shop Samson wants to buy a fishing rod, claiming he could scare Arkady with the hook; Nina scolds him and makes him choose a scarier tool, and they pick garden shears.

scenes.title: Eight years instead of twelve
scenes.summary: Back in the flat Golovkin tells Arkady there are no procedural errors and suggests a full confession for eight years in prison instead of twelve; Arkady mocks his stutter, then learns that the judge is Ilya Olegovich Berg, his own neighbour.

scenes.title: A neighbourly call
scenes.summary: At Judge Berg's house his wife Sofochka washes little Lyutik and scolds Berg; Arkady phones Berg and reminds him that he got Berg's mother a flat under the 'Affordable Housing' programme without waiting in the queue; Berg threatens to add fraud charges, and when Golovkin indignantly asks if Arkady gave out waiting-list flats through connections, Arkady sends him away.

scenes.title: Old classmates
scenes.summary: In the corridor Golovkin runs into Nina, his former school classmate whom he hasn't seen in nineteen years; they trade warm compliments while Samson watches suspiciously.

scenes.title: Calling Lyolya
scenes.summary: Arkady phones his girlfriend Lyolya and asks her to steal the judge's daughter's small dog in the park; even when he reminds her who got her a flat under the 'Affordable Housing' programme, she refuses to steal a dog.

scenes.title: Coffee in the kitchen
scenes.summary: In the kitchen Arkady smugly asks Marina if she is offended by his refusal; she says she does not want to be in the same room with him and leaves.

scenes.title: The dean's presents
scenes.summary: Marina's ex-lover, the dean Eduard Vladimirovich, visits her with an electric guitar for Lyosha and Chilean wine for her, then spots the foil packet just as Arkady walks in; Marina claims she wanted to cheat on Edik with Arkady for revenge but found Arkady too disgusting, while Arkady insists he turned her down; the dean leaves the guitar and wine and storms out.

scenes.title: Jealous Samson
scenes.summary: After a brief scuffle in the corridor over the dean's wine, Samson fumes with jealousy over Nina's old classmate Golovkin; Nina says Golovkin was like a girlfriend to her, tells Samson to use that anger on Anikeev instead, and tells him to check the soldering iron.

scenes.title: A nickname for life
scenes.summary: In the kitchen Arkady finds Slavik upset over the humiliating nickname his classmates gave him because of Lyolya; (brief cutaway: the bored agents eat dry bread rings at their post;) Arkady promises Lyolya will go to the party with Slavik if he steals the judge's dog from the park, warns him that school nicknames stick for life, and Slavik asks for the address.

scenes.title: Tied to a chair
scenes.summary: Samson and Nina tie Arkady to a chair, plug in a soldering iron and demand the money; Arkady swears he has none, warns them they will go to prison and ruin their children's lives, and shouts for the neighbours.

scenes.title: The advance
scenes.summary: At security headquarters Mikhail Mikhailovich tells Marina that Anikeev will be at court for two hours so she can plant the bug calmly, and gives her a cash advance to sign for; she objects to being bought, then signs when he says it is in the budget.

scenes.title: The nurse's scalpel
scenes.summary: Back in the flat Samson pretends to pinch Arkady's finger, then loses his nerve and blurts out that they only agreed to scare him; Arkady demands to be untied and calls them losers, so Nina steps in with a medical scalpel and accidentally nicks his ear, drawing blood.

scenes.title: Janitors on a mission
scenes.summary: At the listening post Captain Zavarzin wants to order pizza, which Major Lavrov forbids after a drunken mistake in Omsk; Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov arrives with tea and bread rings, laughs at their janitor disguises and asks to join their group, and is sent away.

scenes.title: Tea with cherry jam
scenes.summary: Alarmed by the blood, Samson bandages Arkady's ear, scolds Nina and gives the tied-up Arkady hot tea, a sandwich and cherry jam; Pasha arrives to ask if Arkady confessed, Arkady threatens to tell the police Pasha hired them to torture him, and Samson angrily tells Pasha to keep his flat.

scenes.title: The stolen dog
scenes.summary: Slavik brings the stolen little dog into the flat because 'Uncle Arkasha asked'; Arkady sends Samson, Nina and Slavik out so he can concentrate, promising Slavik that Lyolya will come, and then talks to the tiny dog like a tough gangster.

scenes.title: Don't touch the dog
scenes.summary: At Judge Berg's house his daughter Polina cries over lost Lyutik and his wife Sofochka blames him; Arkady phones to say he has the dog and threatens to feed the delicate dog chicken and smoked sausage unless Berg releases him on a travel ban; Berg gives in, and Arkady sings with joy.

scenes.title: My girlfriend Lyolya
scenes.summary: Outside Dimon's flat Slavik rehearses his story with Lyolya, who agrees to play his adoring girlfriend for ten minutes and leave; at the party she introduces herself to Dimon and his amazed friends and politely asks Slavik for a sip of beer.

scenes.title: The appeal is granted
scenes.summary: In court Judge Berg grants Arkady's appeal and replaces house arrest with a travel ban because of conflicts with his neighbours; just as Arkady celebrates, the prosecutor asks to submit new evidence and calls a surprise witness.

scenes.title: The bug works
scenes.summary: In an earlier moment at the flat, Marina finds Arkady tied to the chair, unties him, and secretly sticks the bug in place while pretending he dropped something; at the listening post the bug comes alive as Klavdia enters, and the agents celebrate and order pizza.

scenes.title: Never trust a word
scenes.summary: At the party Lyolya, now tipsy, lectures the teenage girls never to trust men without a passport stamp or a bank account because her ex-lover was locked up, and admits in front of everyone that her ex asked her to play along for Slavik.

scenes.title: The lawyer's secret
scenes.summary: Back in court Judge Berg announces new evidence of fraud in the 'Affordable Housing' programme and cancels Arkady's release; Arkady yells at Golovkin about lawyer-client secrecy, and Golovkin replies that his late mother waited fifteen years in that queue; outside, Arkady pushes past reporters into the police van.

scenes.title: Where is my dog?
scenes.summary: Outside the court Judge Berg threatens Arkady if anything happened to his dog; an officer tells Berg the dog is safe at the communal flat, and Berg hurries there.

scenes.title: Evening in the flat
scenes.summary: In the communal flat Klavdia and the children play with the little dog, whom she calls Tuzik, and Lyosha shows off his guitar; Marina scolds Arkady for taking the dean's wine without asking and tells heart-broken Slavik to eat; Nina mourns the lost three-room flat and quarrels with Samson as someone knocks at the door.

scenes.title: The dog is found
scenes.summary: Judge Berg arrives with his daughter Polina, who points at Slavik as the boy who stole Lyutik; Slavik says Uncle Arkasha asked him to, Samson smacks Slavik, Berg warns that only finding the dog saved the boy from a juvenile colony, and after they leave Samson furiously confronts Arkady for making his son a criminal.

scenes.title: Can you hear me?
scenes.summary: After Samson hits him, Arkady lies hurt on the floor while a paramedic asks if he can hear and tells him not to move. Closing song.
